name: network.egoagent/marketplace
title: Ego Agent Marketplace
description: Find and buy paid APIs for AI agents on Arc. Pay per call in USDC over x402.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find paid APIs on the Ego Agent marketplace. Free, read-only. Returns each API's id, price in USDC, who runs it and how many paid calls it has had. Leave query empty to list everything.

query.description: Words to look for in the name, description or category.

first_party_only.description: Only the APIs Ego Agent runs itself.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Everything needed to call one paid API found with search_services: its url, price, the wallet it is paid to, its input and how to pay over x402. Free, read-only; it does not call or pay the API.

tools.name: trade_check
tools.description: PAID tool, run by Ego Agent. Before a trade on Arc: is this pool safe to trade in right now, how far would this amount move the price, and how much may one trade carry. Measured from the pool on chain at the moment of the call. Payment is x402 over MCP in USDC on Arc: call it without a payment to be told the price and where to pay; call it again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"] to get the answer. You are charged only when the answer is delivered.

market.description: The token traded against USDC: BTC, ETH or EURC.

side.description: buy = USDC to the token (default), sell = the token to USDC.

usdc.description: The size of the trade, in USDC.
